remarks.name: Amjad Masad
remarks.role: ceo replit. civilizationist
remarks.text:
Honored to have the Mayor of London, Sadiq Khan, help us open Replit’s first international office in London!

I’ve really appreciated the Mayor’s approach to AI, it feels very similar to ours. He calls himself an AI realist: clear-eyed about the disruption AI will create, but optimistic about the impact if we give people the tools and skills to participate in the coming revolution.

That’s exactly how we think about it at Replit. AI is going to transform work, so we have to make sure far more people can use it to create, build businesses, and access new opportunities.

It’s also why, as we establish ourselves here, we’re partnering with The Lord Mayor’s Appeal to help young Londoners from disadvantaged communities develop practical coding and AI skills.

London has the history, the talent, and the right leadership & philosophy for the AI era. We’re excited to be here.
remarks.translation: 很荣幸邀请到伦敦市长萨迪克·汗，帮助我们开设Replit在伦敦的首个国际办公室！我非常欣赏市长对人工智能的态度，这与我们的理念非常相似。他称自己为AI现实主义者：对AI将带来的颠覆有着清醒的认识，但同时也乐观地认为，如果我们赋予人们参与这场即将到来的革命的工具和技能，其影响将是积极的。这正是我们在Replit的思考方式。AI将改变工作方式，因此我们必须确保更多的人能够利用它来创造、创业，并获得新的机会。这也是为什么，随着我们在这里扎根，我们正在与伦敦市长慈善机构合作，帮助来自弱势社区的伦敦年轻人培养实用的编程和AI技能。伦敦拥有历史、人才，以及适合AI时代的正确领导力和理念。我们很高兴来到这里。

remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
Good reminder here that with rapidly accelerating AI progress, you should likely be building with a vision that contemplates at least a few orders of magnitude of capability improvement or token volume available to you.

The best opportunities right now are those where you can value to customers today with things that are barely only possible, but with a full mission that feels nearly impossible with today’s tech.

There are lots of products the require orders of magnitude more processing of data (and thus are barely economically viable ideas) or where model capabilities still are in their infancy relative to what’s needed to work. Best to be building for those scenarios.
remarks.translation: 这里有一个很好的提醒：随着人工智能进展迅速加速，你在构建时很可能应该怀有一个愿景，考虑到至少几个数量级的能力提升或可用的token量增长。目前最好的机会是那些你今天就能用勉强可行的技术为客户创造价值，但完整使命在当今技术下几乎不可能实现的方向。有很多产品需要比现在多几个数量级的数据处理能力（因此目前在经济上几乎不可行的想法），或者模型能力相对于所需水平仍处于起步阶段。最好是为这些场景进行构建。

remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
The AI jobs prediction so far is playing out the opposite of what many thought.

The reason this is happening is because AI is bringing automation to areas that don’t have finite demand characteristics. AI allows companies to do far more than they could before, but agents still require human operators and oversight to generate value from them. 

And not only has AI not replaced many of the types of jobs that theoretically would have been most affected by AI - engineers or lawyers - but AI is also creating or growing entire categories of jobs across the economy. 

Cybersecurity, FDEs, agent operators, engineers in non-software domains, and tons of job categories are going to explode. It’s not clear if or when this trend will reverse because we keep discovering all new areas of demand that AI is going to open up.
remarks.translation: 到目前为止，AI就业预测的结果与许多人的想法正好相反。之所以出现这种情况，是因为AI正在把自动化带入那些需求特征并非有限的领域。AI让公司能够做到远超以往的事情，但智能体仍然需要人类操作员和监督才能从中产生价值。而且，AI不仅没有取代许多理论上最可能受AI影响的岗位——比如工程师或律师——反而还在整个经济中创造或壮大了整类整类的职业。网络安全、FDE、智能体操作员、非软件领域的工程师，以及大量职业类别都将迎来爆发式增长。目前尚不清楚这一趋势是否或何时会逆转，因为我们不断发现AI将打开的全新需求领域。

remarks.text:
I don’t think we’ve reached AGI but what we have is functionally indistinguishable from AGI.

Because we have a relentless programmer that doesn’t get bored or tired.

So any problem that can be casted as a coding problem is virtually solved. https://t.co/4FOEW6VVbA
remarks.translation: 我认为我们尚未达到AGI，但我们现在所拥有的东西在功能上与AGI无法区分。因为我们有一个不知疲倦、不会感到无聊或疲惫的程序员。因此，任何可以被转化为编码问题的问题，实际上都已得到解决。https://t.co/4FOEW6VVbA

podcasts.excerpt: 几年前，加州理工学院教授、Accelerated Understanding联合创始人Anima Anandkumar着手开发首个基于AI的开源天气模型。在与该领域专家交流时，她遭遇了质疑。天气是混沌的，物理模拟很难，已经发展了几十年，并且需要超级计算机，数据根本不够。尽管有这些保留意见，Anima还是坚持前行并着手构建。不到一年，她的团队就开发出了FourCastNet，一个能与现有最佳物理模拟相媲美的预测模型。多亏了Anima及其后续工作，现在任何人都可以使用消费级GPU在短时间尺度上准确预测天气。在我们发布的十五期左右的科学节目中，<a target="_blank" href="http://latent.…
podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs.
